decision_rationale: All 11 Pre-Tag sub-audits + Phase-1 build + Phase-1 gate runs confirm autodev-ai is technically ready for v0.1.0a1 tag push. No technical blocker remains. The only requirement before publishing to PyPI is operational: user must set the PYPI_API_TOKEN GitHub secret. Without it, tag push still publishes a GitHub Release and Docker image, but PyPI upload is skipped (workflow design).

github_actions_workflows_triggered: publish (needs:test → build → twine check → GitHub Release attach)
without_pypi_api_token_set.expected_outcome: GitHub Release v0.1.0a1 created with wheel+sdist attached + Docker image published to ghcr.io. PyPI upload skipped silently.
without_pypi_api_token_set.rollback_difficulty: Easy: gh release delete + docker tag repoint. Tag remains as historical marker.
without_pypi_api_token_set.advice: This is a SAFE dry-run if user wants to verify the workflow end-to-end before committing to PyPI.

with_pypi_api_token_set.expected_outcome: PyPI 0.1.0a1 live; pip install --pre autodev-ai works; Homebrew unblocks (after manual sha256 update step)
with_pypi_api_token_set.rollback_difficulty: PyPI yank only marks 'do not install' for new resolutions; existing pinned installs still work. Forward-only fix policy: any post-publish issue requires shipping 0.1.0a2.

homebrew_blocked_reason: Formula sha256 is TODO_PUBLISH_SHA256 placeholder; unblocks 5-min after PyPI publish per packaging/homebrew/PUBLISH_CHECKLIST.md
production_enterprise_blocked_reason: Scope-deferred to R4: SLSA provenance, SBOM, per-caller MCP auth, egress sandbox, signed Docker, cleanup TOCTOU mitigation

user_pre_tag_verifications.purpose: Verify the public-facing release statement matches your intent

user_pre_tag_verifications.action: Confirm git working tree is clean
Confirm tag is not already used

options: A) Tag-only first (dry-run): push tag WITHOUT setting PYPI_API_TOKEN. Verify workflow + GitHub Release + Docker image. PyPI step auto-skips. Set secret later and re-tag 0.1.0a2 if needed (PyPI burned a1 in dry-run scenario means just publishing later).
B) Tag + publish: set PYPI_API_TOKEN first, then tag push. PyPI + GitHub Release + Docker all created from one push.
